bulk_import.note: Bulk import is app-side: the app parses one account per pasted line into accounts.json. The bot only reads accounts.json, so both sides agree on that file. Claim DM is intro + credentials only, with no footer warnings.

description: First-come giveaway bot: one account per Telegram user, channel-join check, credentials by private DM only.
name: Giveaway Bot
notes: Secrets are never stored in this repo. Token and accounts are filled in the manager app and written to the VPS only. v2.0.3 supports bulk import and code-only accounts; channel values may be a plain name, @name, or a full t.me link.
runtime: python3, standard library only, no pip packages
